text:
Sam: Heads-up 10am PT interview with Ivy Springs tomorrow. Goal: 1 short case writeup, one pull-quote for the blog + a 20s spoken clip for the webinar. Can legal preview quote by EOD?
Priya: I'll run the interview and capture raw video. Will also grab a 20s clean take for the webinar slide.
Opsbot: Recording placeholder created: https://drive.redwood/ivy_springs/session_3287.mov
Tom (sales): For lead routing, we want a two-field form (email + interest level) and tagging to "Ivy Webinar" campaign. Can I get a 1-line quote by 11am so SDRs have copy?
Priya: I'll ask Hana (Ivy PM) to give a 1-2 sentence soundbite live. Prefer something that doesn't include specific %s.
Laila (legal): Quick policy: any numeric claims (%, ms) require written signoff from the customer. If they insist on numbers, we need an email thread or signed release. Otherwise we can publish redacted text like "substantial reduction in per-request cost."
Sam: Noted. Draft candidate quote (from Hana): "After switching to Redwood, our per-request cost dropped nearly 35% and median latency improved notably." Posting for legal.
Laila (legal): Please replace "nearly 35%" with "substantial" or attach approval. Also avoid internal metric names; use "median latency" is ok.
Tom (sales): If we end up with the cleaned line, I'll use this for the slide: "Ivy Springs saw substantial per-request cost reductions and faster latency." Works?
Priya: Yes. I'll capture both raw and a short clean take where Hana reads the cleaned version.
Sam: Timeline: Interview tomorrow 10am PT -> Priya uploads raw + clip by 3pm -> Laila to approve or request redaction by 6pm -> Tom builds Typeform + webhook to SFDC by EOD.
Tom (sales): On it. Will name the SFDC queue: "Ivy Webinar - Interest" and add UTM params to form.
Laila (legal): If the customer wants to keep numbers but not public, we can include them in a locked case file for sales collateral internal use. Public copy must be non-numeric without explicit consent.
Priya: Noted. Also capturing short B-roll of the demo UI for the blog hero.
Sam: Perfect. Opsbot, set a reminder to follow up with legal in 4 hours.
Opsbot: Reminder scheduled: legal follow-up in 4 hours. :bell:
Priya: I'll post links here as soon as uploads complete.
Sam: Thanks team. Minimal ask: one approved sentence for the webinar by noon so Tom can prep SDR playbook. :rocket:
